acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

getActiveValidatorsLength().details: Kept O(1) and behaviorally identical for its heuristic readers. Any consumer         that must be epoch-correct — above all the selection view — MUST use         `getActiveValidatorsLengthAt`.

getActiveValidatorsLengthAt(uint64).details: Immutable for every epoch that has already started: the setter only ever         schedules `fromEpoch = currentEpoch + 1`, so no call can change the answer         for `epoch <= currentEpoch`. This is the leg that makes         `StakingLayout.getValidatorsAt` a pure function of its epoch argument.         Backward scan; governance writes are rare, so it is O(1-2) in practice.

getBlendStipendPerEpoch().details: RAW getter: 0 == the BLEND stipend is OFF (kill-switch). NOT a sentinel default.

getProductionLivenessDisabled().details: RAW getter: true == the production-liveness tier is OFF. Seeded TRUE at init (the      tier ships flag-off), which is the OPPOSITE default to      `getParticipationJailDisabled` — do not pattern-match the two.

getSlashFundAddress().details: RAW getter: address(0) == fund unset ⇒ the seizure remainder is burned. NOT a sentinel.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setActiveValidatorsLength(uint32).details: Takes SELECTION effect at the next epoch, not immediately. The deferral is         what buys the purity of `getActiveValidatorsLengthAt` for past epochs (see         `CapCheckpoint`); it is also why the first committee affected by a change         made during epoch E is `committee[E+3]` — selection at E+1, committed two         epochs ahead. The scalar getter still reports `newValue` immediately, so a         governance readback right after the call is unchanged.

setBlendStipendPerEpoch(uint256).details: Deviation from the sentinel idiom: 0 is a valid (off) value, so `require(>0)` is      dropped; the MAX cap + event stay.

setExclusionBackoffCap(uint32).details: Ceiling on the LINEAR exclusion ladder, in selection epochs. There is deliberately      no companion "base" knob: the duration is `min(kickCount, cap)` and reads no base,      so shipping one would be a live governance control that changes nothing.

setMinVerdictDueBlocks(uint32).details: The due-count floor below which a committee member holds NO verdict for an epoch.      Raising it carves smaller stakes out of judgement entirely; lowering it exposes      them to chance failures that compound superlinearly, because the backoff is linear      and `kickCount` never decays. Bounded away from 0 (which would judge every member,      including one that was never due a single slot) and by an absolute ceiling (a floor      above the epoch length disables the tier silently).

setProductionLivenessDisabled(bool).details: Governance kill switch for the production-liveness tier. While disabled the      recorder keeps counting and publishing, but no verdict is evaluated, no exclusion      is stamped and none expires — the VERDICT STATE is frozen, not the counters.      That is deliberate and is the one thing this switch does differently from the      participation jail it replaces, whose cursor advanced anyway and left every window      finalized-while-disabled permanently unjudged.

setSlashFundAddress(address).details: Non-zero only: once a damage-coverage fund is wired, governance rotates it to another      fund rather than back to burn (the dead-address burn is the genesis default, reachable      only while the slot is still unset). Mirrors the setBlsVerifier / setEvidenceDecoder idiom.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

DEFAULT_EXCLUSION_BACKOFF_CAP().notice: Default ceiling on the exclusion backoff, in SELECTION epochs. The ladder is         LINEAR in the episode count (1, 2, 3, …) — a geometric tail was declined — so         this caps the ladder rather than shaping it.

DEFAULT_MIN_VERDICT_DUE_BLOCKS().notice: Default minimum `due` block count below which a committee member holds NO         verdict for an epoch. 100, chosen on COMPOUNDING cost rather than the         per-epoch rate: the count credited to a member is ~Poisson(due), so a seat         sitting exactly at a floor of 20 is wrongly failed by chance ~0.50% of epochs,         and because the backoff is linear and `kickCount` never decays, cumulative         excluded time grows as N(N+1)/2 — roughly five months per decade for a         validator that performed at exactly the fleet average the whole time. At 100         the same seat is at ~1e-6 per epoch. The price is that seats below ~0.116% of         committee stake become unjudgeable.

DEFAULT_SLASH_REPORTER_BPS().notice: Default reporter cut (basis points) of an equivocation stake seizure, used         when the `_slashReporterRewardBps` slot is unset (0). 3000 = 30% reporter,         70% burned.

MAX_ACTIVE_VALIDATORS().notice: Hard cap on `activeValidatorsLength` (the COMMITTEE size; the         tier-2 registry fed to the p2p tracker is uncapped here). MUST         stay byte-equal to `fluentbase_p2p::constants::MAX_COMMITTEE_SIZE`         (51) and ≤ 255 (the `committee_size: u8` extra-data wire format).         Raising it requires a coordinated bump on both the contract and         the Rust consensus side in the same release.

MAX_BLEND_STIPEND_PER_EPOCH().notice: Sanity cap on the per-epoch BLEND stipend.

MAX_MIN_VERDICT_DUE_BLOCKS().notice: Hard cap on `minVerdictDueBlocks`. A floor above the epoch length makes         `due >= floor` unsatisfiable for EVERY member at any stake, silently disabling         the tier while it still reads as enabled — the same failure class as a         governance knob that does nothing. Bounded absolutely rather than against the         epoch length so the check cannot itself become interval-dependent.

MAX_SLASH_REPORTER_BPS().notice: Upper bound on the reporter cut. Capped strictly below 100% so an         equivocation seizure always destroys real capital (the burned remainder is         the economic deterrent). A 100% reporter cut would let a colluding         self-reporter recover the entire seized self-stake, neutering the penalty.

getActiveValidatorsLength().notice: The LATEST SCHEDULED committee-size cap — what governance last set, which         during the epoch of a change is NOT yet the cap selection cuts with.

getActiveValidatorsLengthAt(uint64).notice: The committee-size cap in force for `epoch`.

getBlsVerifier().notice: Address of the BLS12-381 MinSig verify contract.

getDposActivationBlock().notice: Block at which DPoS epoch numbering rebases to zero (0 ⇒ absolute).

getEpochBlockInterval().notice: Number of blocks in one staking epoch.

getEvidenceDecoder().notice: Address of the Simplex equivocation-evidence decoder contract.

getExclusionBackoffCap().notice: Ceiling on the LINEAR exclusion ladder, in selection epochs. There is no         companion "base" knob by design: the duration is `min(kickCount, cap)`.

getMinStakingAmount().notice: Minimum delegation amount accepted by staking.

getMinValidatorStakeAmount().notice: Minimum self-stake required to register a validator.

getMinVerdictDueBlocks().notice: Minimum expected block count (`due`) below which a committee member holds NO         verdict for an epoch. RAW value, seeded at init — 0 is not "unset", it is         "judge everyone", and the setter refuses it.

getSlashReporterRewardBps().notice: Reporter's cut (basis points) of an equivocation stake seizure; the         remainder is burned. Defaults to 3000 (30%) when unset (sentinel).

getUndelegatePeriod().notice: Number of epochs before undelegated funds become claimable.

setBlsVerifier(address).notice: Updates the BLS verifier address. Callable by governance.

setDposActivationBlock(uint64).notice: Sets the DPoS activation block (aligned, not in the past). Callable by governance.

setEpochBlockInterval(uint32).notice: Updates the staking epoch length. Callable by governance.

setEvidenceDecoder(address).notice: Updates the evidence decoder address. Callable by governance.

setMinStakingAmount(uint256).notice: Updates minimum delegation amount. Callable by governance.

setMinValidatorStakeAmount(uint256).notice: Updates validator registration minimum stake. Callable by governance.

setSlashReporterRewardBps(uint32).notice: Updates the equivocation reporter reward (basis points). Callable by governance.

setUndelegatePeriod(uint32).notice: Updates the undelegation delay in epochs. Callable by governance.
